<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 134.10955, which likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral molecular mass is approximately 133.10 Da. A plausible formula that matches this mass using only C, H, O atoms is C₇H₁₇O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H17O2</final_answer>
